_meta.description: Seed for <repo>/agents-info/translator/glossary.json (EN→UK). The banned lists are general Ukrainian usage, the same for every product; the product categories are placeholders: replace them with this product's words.

rules.voice_web: ви (formal) for web pages, landing, SEO
rules.voice_bot: ти (informal) for bot and in-app chat

product.<source term>: <the one Ukrainian rendering this product uses>

bannedAnglicisms._note: Borrowed English with a native Ukrainian equivalent. A product may un-ban one deliberately (e.g. a gaming audience that really says 'стрім'); remove it from its own copy of this file.
bannedAnglicisms.фокус (концентрація): зосередженість / увага; 'фокус' is mainly a magic trick in Ukrainian

bannedRussianisms._note: Russian-rooted forms with proper Ukrainian equivalents.
bannedRussianisms.знаходиться / знаходяться: перебуває / перебувають (for 'is located / is in a state')
